post.summary: Identity bridge: what an external identity may do
post.description: Resolves the external identity against `externalEntitlements` — the record of the person (by subject at that provider, else by email), else the record of their email domain — and answers the capabilities and the organization their content lives in. **No side effect**: no key, no token, no organization is created, so warming a cache at login never provisions anything. Auth: a SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATOR credential with `?userScope=backoffice`.

parameters.name: userScope
parameters.description: `backoffice` — the SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATOR credential of the integration acts across organizations

provider.description: the external system presenting the identity (one per Meet instance)

subject.description: stable id of the person at the provider (e.g. the OIDC sub)

email.description: email of the person (lowercased server-side); the pivot between systems and the input of the domain resolution

organizationId.description: the organization of the person's domain (B2B) or the root organization (B2C)

capabilities.description: Computed from the entitlement at the time of the call, never stored on the key.

403.description: The caller is not a SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATOR acting with `?userScope=backoffice`

404.description: No entitlement stands for this identity, or every feature is off (`code: no_entitlement`)

post.summary: Identity bridge: exchange an external identity for a short token of its API key
post.description: Same resolution as `/resolve`, then the key standing for that person — found by (provider, subject), then by email, or **created just-in-time** in the organization the resolution yields when the person has an entitlement and no key yet. Mints a token that expires after `EXTERNAL_EXCHANGE_TOKEN_TTL` (default 1h) as a dedicated `tokens` row, revocable on its own; the token inherits the key's organization role. The key carries the identity only — the rights are re-read from the entitlement on every gated call — and the long-lived key is never returned. Called only when the person actually starts something. Auth: a SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATOR credential with `?userScope=backoffice`.

parameters.name: userScope
parameters.description: `backoffice` — the SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATOR credential of the integration acts across organizations

provider.description: the external system presenting the identity (one per Meet instance)

subject.description: stable id of the person at the provider (e.g. the OIDC sub)

email.description: email of the person (lowercased server-side); the pivot between systems and the input of the domain resolution

userId.description: id of the API key (a machine user)

capabilities.description: Computed from the entitlement at the time of the call, never stored on the key.

created.description: true when the key was created just-in-time by this call

403.description: The caller is not a SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATOR acting with `?userScope=backoffice`, or the linked key has been revoked (`code: revoked`)

404.description: No entitlement stands for this identity, or every feature is off (`code: no_entitlement`)
